executive_summary: CKA seq 8 re-examines the 9/10 eyewitness pattern. Host surfaces GMA interview with Tiffany Barker and her later artery-explanation video, then walks a timeline placing George Zinn's arrest inside ~1:48 of the SUV departure. She highlights a Wirefy-branded individual filming immediately post-shot, and traces a viral roof-shooter video through Chicago-based phone numbers before speaking to an eyewitness whose metadata at 12:22–12:23 contradicts the FBI's public shooter description (tactical gear vs jeans/flag shirt). She then plays Andrew Kolvet's Alex Clark interview (Catholic conversion, $150M Israel, SD cards, moral blackmail) and a Charlie Kirk Myrtle Beach clip on moral blackmail. Closes with a Trump audio statement on splitting MMR and delaying Hepatitis B.

claims.label: GMA reached Tiffany Barker via Phil Lyman political channel
claims.claim: The host says Tiffany Barker intimated that Good Morning America's outreach was a political connection: her sister ran as lieutenant governor alongside Phil Lyman, and GMA reached out to Phil Lyman and somehow ended up with her sister's children and her.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Tiffany Barker's LDS/political family ties and the Leman campaign contact chain.
claims.transcript_snippet: her sister ran as lieutenant governor alongside Phil Lyman... Good Morning America reached out to Phil Lyman

claims.label: Children described Charlie's artery wound on GMA
claims.claim: In the Good Morning America clip the host plays, L Steel says she saw blood everywhere and that it hit his artery, and Mia Grant says they were about 15 feet away and she thought the shot was a firecracker.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the children's GMA statements against the video metadata and any device footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: I saw blood everywhere and it hit his artery and then I just we fell to the ground

claims.label: Tiffany Barker Says Artery Detail Came from Car Conversation, Not Observation
claims.claim: In a follow-up video the host plays, Tiffany Barker says the children saw how much Charlie bled and asked why, and she told them during a roughly hour-and-a-half car wait after the shooting, "There's an artery here. Maybe they hit an artery," adding "I didn't know."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original follow-up video and any car-cam footage; verify Tiffany's stated timeline.
claims.transcript_snippet: I said, 'There's an artery here. Maybe they hit an artery.' I didn't know. We didn't know anything.

claims.label: George Zinn Arrested ~1:48 After Shot Near Where Charlie's SUV Departed
claims.claim: Per the host's timeline, ~40 seconds from the shot until Charlie is brought to the SUV and ~1:08 later George Zinn is in handcuffs in the same SUV zone.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently verify the timeline from official police body-cam and security footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: 40 seconds later, Charlie's brought to the SUV... George Zinn is in handcuffs

claims.label: Roof video chain routed through Chicago-based intermediaries

claims.transcript_snippet: the assassin may have used a 10 or 20 round magazine... Hornady VMAX or similar lightweight 223 bullet
